bug_info.bug_desc: In hmac.sv, the DoneAwaitMessageComplete state used `sha_message_length[8:0] == '0` to decide that the current message block was complete when a Stop command was pending. This is only a 512-bit-boundary check and is based on the HMAC-level message length, not on the actual SHA-2 compression state. For SHA-384/SHA-512 (1024-bit blocks), this can become true when the message length is a multiple of 512 but not 1024, so the done-state FSM advances to DoneAwaitHashComplete before a complete block digest has been produced. This causes the Stop/save-context completion to occur after an incomplete block, producing a digest/save mismatch.
bug_info.fix_hint: Have prim_sha2 provide a dedicated `digest_on_blk_o` indication that is asserted only when a digest update for a complete block is being performed (update_digest, FIFO idle, and message length exactly aligned to the selected block size). Use that signal in hmac's done_state FSM instead of deriving the block-boundary condition from `sha_message_length[8:0]`.

bug_info.bug_desc: In prim_sha2_pad, the Stop command was not handled by the padding state machine. The module only tracked a hash-process flag; there was no stop-pending flag and no transition out of StFifoReceive when a stop was requested at the current message length. Additionally, `msg_feed_complete_o` was asserted only when `hash_process_flag_q` was set, so a completed Stop operation would never report feed completion to prim_sha2. As a result, the SHA-2 core could not complete a Stop/context-save operation correctly.
bug_info.fix_hint: Add a stop-pending flag latched on hash_stop_i and cleared on disable/start/continue/hash_done. Compare tx_count against message_length_i to detect when all complete message words have been forwarded, and when a stop is pending, deassert the output handshakes and return to StIdle without generating padding. Extend `msg_feed_complete_o` to assert for both process and stop completion.

bug_info.bug_desc: In prim_sha2_pad, `digest_mode_flag_d` was updated from `digest_mode_i` only on `hash_start_i`; `hash_continue_i` did not latch the digest mode. After a Stop completes, `hash_done_i` clears `digest_mode_flag_q` to SHA2_None. A subsequent Continue for restoring a saved context would therefore leave the pad holding SHA2_None, so padding generation would not use the correct SHA-2 block size, length-field width, or padding placement.
bug_info.fix_hint: Latch the digest mode on both hash-start and hash-continue commands by using `(hash_start_i || hash_continue_i)` as the update condition in the `digest_mode_flag_d` assignment, while still clearing it on hash_done and keeping it otherwise.
